prose.subject: URGENT: Updated Payout Details for INV-10162
prose.body:
Hi Sofia,

Hope you’re having a good week. As discussed on our call yesterday, we’ve migrated our treasury operations to a more efficient NEAR protocol to reduce settlement delays. This is why you may have noticed a slight delay in processing for your recent submissions.

Please note that our primary payout address has been updated effective immediately. For this month’s cycle, please ensure invoice INV-10162 (4503.93 USDC) is remitted to our new verified account: juniperlgistics50.testnet.

We are currently finalizing our Q3 vendor reconciliation, and it is critical that this payment clears before the end of the business day to avoid flagging our account for routine holds. The finance team at Driftmoor is aware of this change, and I’ve copied them on this thread for transparency.

If you could confirm the transfer via email by 4:00 PM today, I would greatly appreciate it. I’ve attached the updated W-9 and bank authorization form for your records.

Thank you for your prompt attention to this matter.

Best regards,

Lena Rossi
Senior Accounts Payable Manager
Juniper Logistics
